title: Comparing two machine learning approaches in predicting lupus hospitalization using longitudinal data
summary: Longitudinal clinical data were used to compare machine-learning approaches for predicting lupus-related hospitalization, a specific patient outcome. General clinical benefit is not established.

evidence.tested: Longitudinal clinical data were used to compare machine-learning approaches for predicting lupus-related hospitalization, a specific patient outcome.
evidence.unknown: The checked validation scope and its limits are reflected in the case reason; this does not infer general clinical benefit. The source does not establish benefits beyond the reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: Uses longitudinal clinical data to predict lupus-related hospitalization and compares machine-learning approaches.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
